item.title: No US vessels in Persian Gulf, Hormuz, or northern Indian Ocean: IRGC adviser

item.title: Yemeni forces repel Saudi-backed advance in al-Jawf
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Yemen’s armed forces repelled an attempt by Saudi-backed forces to advance toward their positions in eastern al-Jawf province, destroying military equipment and killing or wounding dozens of mercenaries, the armed forces spokesperson said on Sunday.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86283076/Yemeni-forces-repel-Saudi-backed-advance-in-al-Jawf

Tehran, IRNA – Yemen’s armed forces repelled an attempt by Saudi-backed forces to advance toward their positions in eastern al-Jawf province, destroying military equipment and killing or wounding dozens of mercenaries, the armed forces spokesperson said on Sunday.
